blockerRemoved: The frozen task now has a mechanically constructed source-only proposer workspace and receipt rather than only a metadata promise that the parent evaluator will be withheld.

measurement.retainedFirstStageResult: 2/8 assertions completed but six cleanup hooks failed because the test attempted to remove intentionally read-only directories.

guidanceChange.prior: The evaluator had to be withheld from proposer input and mounts, but no exact constructed proposer surface was defined.
guidanceChange.proposed: Validate all capsules in the parent, stage only fixed-mode source bytes into a new workspace, serialize a source-only receipt for the child, and retain evaluator paths and hashes only in a separate parent binding.
guidanceChange.expectedBenefit: Reduce accidental evaluator contamination and make the future child launch surface auditable.
guidanceChange.measuredMechanics: The proposer receipt and complete staged workspace were checked for parent-only identities; destination reuse and unsafe archive structure fail closed.
guidanceChange.rollbackCondition: Reject the staged task if parent-only bytes or identities reach the proposer receipt/workspace, capsule validation fails, the task exposes a solution before proposal, or sandbox mount separation cannot be enforced.
guidanceChange.cadenceRationale: Useful bounded integration work remains ready and no claim or writer contention was observed.

largestRemainingUncertainty: Whether inherited training-only failure-analysis state improves descendant successor productivity on genuinely fresh tasks at equal total cost.
nextBlocker: Bind this proposer surface to a child launch on a compatible exclusive-UID isolation host and prove evaluator paths are absent from the sandbox mounts; explicit repair-resource approval is still required before any candidate trial.
